suite: SteamAdapter.switchAccount (real, a Steam that something else started)
name: never closes a Steam it was not allowed to close: the credentials path stops the same way

steps.title: Close Steam
steps.detail: Steam was started by something else while One Launch was switching accounts, so the switch stopped before changing anything. Try again.

steps.title: Start Steam on its sign-in form
Wait for Steam to come up
Wait for you to sign in
steps.detail: Runs only if Steam still asks for something One Launch cannot supply: a Steam Guard code for a PC this account has not used before, an expired session with no stored password, or a session Steam simply refuses. The Steam window stays open on its sign-in form; you sign in there once with "Remember me" ticked and One Launch continues with the game as soon as Steam reports the sign-in, up to 0.0006666666666666666 min. A wrong stored password ends the switch instead.

result.error: Steam was started by something else while One Launch was switching accounts, so the switch stopped before changing anything. Try again.
